inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
echo '--- git status ---'
git status --short
echo '--- direct files ---'
find packages/local-agent-core/src/direct -maxdepth 2 -type f -print 2>/dev/null | sort || true
echo '--- direct scripts ---'
find scripts -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'local-agent-direct*' -print | sort || true
echo '--- direct package scripts ---'
node -e "const p=require('./package.json'); for (const [k,v] of Object.entries(p.scripts||{})) if(k.includes('local-agent:direct')) console.log(k+'='+v)"
echo '--- systemd direct services ---'
systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --type=timer 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'gova-direct-agent|host-discovery' || true
echo '--- direct runtime ---'
find .local/direct-agent -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p %m\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | sed -n '1,120p' || true
